key_idea: Recasting the automorphism as a Borel subadditive function on the reals, then using Baire category and an elegantly constructed bounded dynamical recurrence to recover an irrational parameter without leaving a local region of continuity.
reason: This is a quintessential 'book proof' that achieves a monumental result using incredibly light and elegant means. By shifting the perspective to descriptive set theory and topological dynamics, it collapses a historically massive coding argument into a short, conceptual, and inevitable line of reasoning.
recognized: Slaman-Woodin rigidity of the Turing degrees (recent simplified proof)
